description: Source file implementing filename utility functions for safe path validation and filename generation within the Chromium project, specifically for the net namespace.

methods.name: IsSafePortablePathComponent
methods.description: Checks if a given file path component is safe for portable use, considering filename legality, reserved names, and extension restrictions.

methods.name: IsSafePortableRelativePath
methods.description: Validates if a relative path is safe for portable use by checking each component.

methods.name: GetSuggestedFilename
methods.description: Generates a suggested filename based on URL and content disposition, with options to replace extensions and sanitize characters.

methods.name: GenerateFileName
methods.description: Creates a filename for a download based on URL, content disposition, and other parameters, with optional extension replacement and normalization on ChromeOS.
